# fit_batch_reference { #falconage.fit_batch_reference }

```python
fit_batch_reference(
    data,
    *,
    batch_col,
    covariates=(),
    protect=('condition', 'group'),
    min_batch=MIN_BATCH,
)
```

Fit the frozen global parameters on a reference cohort.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type            | Description                                                                                                                                                         | Default                  |
|------------|-----------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------|
| covariates | Sequence\[str\] | Columns of ``obs`` whose effect should be preserved rather than removed -- typically age and sex. Numeric columns enter as themselves; categorical ones as dummies. | `()`                     |
| protect    | Sequence\[str\] | Columns checked for being nested inside batch. See :func:`_check_confounding`; pass ``()`` to skip.                                                                 | `('condition', 'group')` |
